framework: ISO/IEC 42001:2023 AI management system (selected clauses and Annex A)
note: Identifiers and short titles follow the standard as recalled by the author; verify them against your licensed copy. Summaries and evidence hints are paraphrases written for this tool, not the standard's text. Management-system clauses included are 5.2, 6.1.2-6.1.4, 6.2, 9.2 and 9.3; the other clauses are not listed as separate controls. Impact weights (1-5) are generic defaults.

controls.title: AI policy
controls.summary: Top management sets an AI policy that fits the organisation's purpose, commits to responsible AI and to continual improvement, and communicates it.

controls.title: AI risk assessment
controls.summary: A defined process identifies, analyses and evaluates AI risks, with consistent criteria and results kept as records.
controls.evidence_hint: AI risk assessment procedure, criteria, completed risk assessments.

controls.title: AI risk treatment
controls.summary: Risks are treated with selected controls, compared against Annex A, and recorded in a statement of applicability.
controls.evidence_hint: Risk treatment plan, statement of applicability with justifications.

controls.title: AI system impact assessment
controls.summary: A process assesses the consequences of AI systems for people and society across their life cycle.
controls.evidence_hint: Impact assessment procedure and completed assessments.

controls.title: AI objectives and planning
controls.summary: Measurable AI objectives are set at relevant levels, with plans for who does what, by when and how results are evaluated.
controls.evidence_hint: Objectives register with owners, targets and progress reviews.

controls.title: Internal audit
controls.summary: Planned internal audits check that the AI management system meets requirements and is effective.

controls.title: Management review
controls.summary: Top management reviews the AI management system at planned intervals and records decisions on changes and improvement.
controls.evidence_hint: Management review minutes with required inputs and outputs.

controls.title: AI policy
controls.summary: A documented policy for AI exists, covering how AI is developed, provided or used.
controls.evidence_hint: Approved AI policy and version history.

controls.title: Alignment with other policies
controls.summary: The AI policy is aligned with other organisational policies such as security, privacy and quality.

controls.title: Review of the AI policy
controls.summary: The AI policy is reviewed at planned intervals or after significant change.
controls.evidence_hint: Review records with dates and outcomes.

controls.title: AI roles and responsibilities
controls.summary: Responsibilities for AI are defined and allocated across the organisation.
controls.evidence_hint: RACI or role descriptions for AI governance.

controls.title: Reporting of concerns
controls.summary: A way exists for people to report concerns about AI systems throughout their life cycle.
controls.evidence_hint: Reporting channel, procedure, sample handled reports.

controls.title: Resource documentation
controls.summary: Resources needed for each AI system, such as data, tools, computing and people, are identified and documented.

controls.title: Data resources
controls.summary: Data resources used by AI systems are documented.
controls.evidence_hint: Dataset inventory with sources and owners.

controls.title: Tooling resources
controls.summary: Tools used to build and run AI systems are documented.

controls.title: System and computing resources
controls.summary: Computing and system resources used by AI systems are documented.

controls.title: Human resources
controls.summary: The competence and skills needed for AI work are identified and documented.

controls.domain: A.5 Assessing impacts of AI systems
controls.title: Impact assessment process
controls.summary: A process assesses AI system impacts on individuals, groups and society.

controls.domain: A.5 Assessing impacts of AI systems
controls.title: Documentation of impact assessments
controls.summary: Results of AI system impact assessments are retained.

controls.domain: A.5 Assessing impacts of AI systems
controls.title: Impact on individuals or groups
controls.summary: Potential impacts on people, such as fairness, safety and privacy, are assessed.

controls.domain: A.5 Assessing impacts of AI systems
controls.title: Societal impacts
controls.summary: Wider impacts on society and the environment are assessed.

controls.title: Objectives for responsible development
controls.summary: Objectives that guide responsible AI development are identified and built into the life cycle.
controls.evidence_hint: Documented development objectives such as fairness, safety, transparency.

controls.title: Processes for responsible design and development
controls.summary: Documented processes cover responsible design and development of AI systems.
controls.evidence_hint: Development life cycle procedure with review gates.

controls.title: Requirements and specification
controls.summary: Requirements for each AI system, including responsible-AI needs, are specified.

controls.title: Documentation of design and development
controls.summary: Design choices and how the system was built are documented.
controls.evidence_hint: Design records, model cards or equivalent.

controls.title: Verification and validation
controls.summary: Verification and validation measures and criteria are defined and applied.
controls.evidence_hint: Test plans, evaluation results, acceptance criteria.

controls.title: Deployment
controls.summary: A deployment plan exists and requirements are met before release.

controls.title: Operation and monitoring
controls.summary: Elements for ongoing operation, such as monitoring, repair, updates and support, are defined.
controls.evidence_hint: Monitoring dashboards, drift reports, support procedures.

controls.title: Technical documentation
controls.summary: Technical documentation is prepared for relevant interested parties.
controls.evidence_hint: User, operator and technical documentation sets.

controls.title: Event log recording
controls.summary: Event logs of AI system operation are recorded to the extent needed.

controls.title: Data for development and enhancement
controls.summary: Data management processes are defined for AI development and improvement.

controls.title: Acquisition of data
controls.summary: How data is acquired and selected is determined and documented.

controls.title: Quality of data
controls.summary: Data quality requirements are defined and met for AI systems.
controls.evidence_hint: Data quality criteria and check results.

controls.title: Data provenance
controls.summary: The origin and history of data is recorded.

controls.title: Data preparation
controls.summary: Data preparation methods and criteria are defined and documented.

controls.title: System documentation and information for users
controls.summary: Information users need to understand and use the AI system properly is provided.

controls.title: External reporting
controls.summary: A way exists for outside parties to report adverse impacts.
controls.evidence_hint: External contact channel and handling procedure.

controls.title: Communication of incidents
controls.summary: A process is defined for telling interested parties about AI incidents.

controls.title: Information for interested parties
controls.summary: Information duties to interested parties, including legal ones, are identified and met.

controls.title: Processes for responsible use
controls.summary: Processes for responsible use of AI systems are defined and documented.

controls.title: Objectives for responsible use
controls.summary: Objectives guiding responsible use of AI are identified.

controls.title: Intended use
controls.summary: AI systems are used according to their intended use and documentation.
controls.evidence_hint: Controls that prevent or detect out-of-scope use.

controls.title: Allocating responsibilities
controls.summary: Responsibilities between the organisation, partners, suppliers and customers are allocated.

controls.title: Suppliers
controls.summary: A process makes sure supplied AI services and components fit the organisation's responsible AI approach.
controls.evidence_hint: Supplier assessment records and contract terms.

controls.title: Customers
controls.summary: Customer needs and expectations for responsible AI are considered.
controls.evidence_hint: Customer requirement handling and feedback records.
